mod_compile.note_on_load_mechanisms: Modern NEURON places libnrnmech.so directly in x86_64/ (not in x86_64/.libs/ as older versions did). 'load_mechanisms("x86_64")' from Python returns False because it looks for the legacy path, but hasattr(h, 'bkt80') etc. all return True because NEURON auto-loads x86_64/libnrnmech.so from CWD on import.
